mechanism_probe_on_unmodified_base.description: Write old, create AuthStorage, immediately overwrite with the new credential, record cached/current stat revision, then use the original gated-lock two-reader cancellation sequence.
mechanism_probe_on_unmodified_base.interpretation: On this filesystem, consecutive equal-length writes can preserve dev, inode, size, mtimeNs and ctimeNs. AuthStorage then returns its cached old credential without entering the reload whose cancellation semantics the upstream case intends to test. Counts describe these bounded diagnostic runs, not an estimated failure probability.
